contract.capacity_vs_consumption: equal offered resource capacities; actual paid/cancelled/censored consumption can differ
contract.credit: required integer work on the observer's final selected branch; stale/private work earns no adopted credit
contract.honest_fast_epochs: short honest epochs are admitted under the same timestamp and clamp rules
contract.horizon: unfinished final attempts retain incurred cost and unknown future outcomes; early stops are incomplete
contract.network: same fixed complete-bundle delivery delay; no bandwidth, byte budget, validation queue or eclipse model
contract.pairing: same seed, duration, processor count, oracle/proof clocks, classical rates, shocks and delivery latency
contract.policy_selection: two fixed policies; no fitting, optimization, training or held-out efficacy claim
contract.private_policy: parent timestamp plus one; publish at three quarters of the horizon; omit the public probe
contract.roster: all declared seeds, both policies, both arms and every environment; no post-sample selection
contract.scope: conditional event observations; no native W1 execution or physical calibration
contract.seed_pairing: same per-miner seed; policy changes alter event ordering and random-number consumption
contract.task_supply: UNIMPLEMENTED; proof-cost sensitivity and participation shocks are not task-supply experiments
